# Conrad Holtzhausen

> Conrad Holtzhausen is an Engineering Manager and Senior Frontend Software Engineer based in South Africa. He has worked in tech since 2010 and has built SaaS software since 2015.

- Career path: Web Designer (from 2010), then Frontend Engineer, then Engineering Manager (since May 2024).
- As an engineer: pragmatic, balances shipping today with a plan to iterate later, and has been tech lead on large initiatives end-to-end.
- As a manager: trusts engineers by default, has managed multiple teams at once, and values team fun and shared goals.
